title: Normalized tensor-section functor, unit and etale restriction comparisons for line modules
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Put $\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}(u:U\to X)=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$. Modules on a site and their morphisms mean sheaves of modules and all module morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an ordinary invertible module $L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], set $A_X(L)(u)=\Gamma(U,u^*L)$ [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], with pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and its unit-normalized restrictions. The sectionwise scalar actions make $A_X(L)$ a module sheaf; the formula $A_X(h)_u=\Gamma(U,u^*h)$ defines a functor on ordinary invertible modules. There is a natural module-sheaf isomorphism $\epsilon_X:A_X(\mathcal O_X)\simeq\mathcal O_{X,\mathrm{et}}$ whose component is the tensor-unit map $a\otimes b\mapsto a\,u^\sharp(b)$, with inverse $a\mapsto a\otimes1$. For every etale $v:Y\to X$, pullback $v^*L$ is invertible and there is a natural module-sheaf isomorphism $\beta_{v,L}:A_X(L)|_{Y_{\mathrm{et}}}\simeq A_Y(v^*L)$ whose component at $w:W\to Y$ is $\Gamma(W,c_{w,v,L}^{-1})$, where $c_{w,v,L}:w^*v^*L\simeq(v\circ w)^*L$ is the unit-normalized tensor composition comparison. These components commute with all site restrictions and satisfy $\beta_{v,K}\,A_X(h)|_Y=A_Y(v^*h)\,\beta_{v,L}$. Let $i_L:\mathrm{id}_X^*L\simeq L$ be the tensor-unit identity comparison. Then $A_X(i_L)\,\beta_{\mathrm{id}_X,L}$ is the identity under the canonical identification of restriction along $\mathrm{id}_X$. For etale $z:Z\to Y$ one has $A_Z(c_{z,v,L})\,\beta_{z,v^*L}\,(\beta_{v,L}|_Z)=\beta_{v\circ z,L}$, with the canonical identification of iterated restriction understood. The structure-module comparison and these restriction maps commute via the same tensor-unit identifications. Moreover, any Zariski trivializing cover $j_i:V_i\hookrightarrow X$ of $L$ gives an etale trivializing cover of $A_X(L)$, with local frames obtained by applying $A_{V_i}$ to $j_i^*L\simeq\mathcal O_{V_i}$ and using $\beta$ and $\epsilon$.

proof.text: Use lem-trf-etale-line-sections-coordinates to obtain A, alpha, epsilon, pullback invertibility and beta, with the scalar, module-map, unit and restriction coordinate equations. The coordinates are the same actual tensor-section sheaf as in the statement.

Derive the inverse-unit formula by applying the inverse tensor-unit map to the forward-unit coordinate equation and cancelling epsilon. Naturality of tensorSectionsComp inverse, evaluated on global sections, and injectivity of alpha give naturality of beta for every module map. Apply the identity and composition equations of lem-trf-tensor-sections-coordinate-coherence in alpha coordinates; naturality of alpha moves the canonical site-object restrictions across the coordinate map. Injectivity of alpha proves both required equations. Its structure-unit equation, with the epsilon, module-map and beta coordinate formulas, gives unit compatibility.

For any prescribed Zariski cover, its open-immersion arrows are jointly surjective and etale. At the terminal etale object the sieve generated by these arrows is covering by the small-etale topology criterion, and is contained in the sieve of objects of the cover; thus they cover top. Define each tau as beta followed by the functor image of the supplied frame and epsilon, forgetting to module presheaves. Functors preserve isomorphisms. The required formula is the component of this composite, by definition. This applies to infinite covers and to an empty scheme with its empty cover.
